name: Steady Stacker
summary: Fixed-amount buys on a schedule, split across a basket of testnet stock tokens (TSLA, AMZN, PLTR, NFLX, AMD).

name: Dip Hunter
summary: A ladder of buy-limit orders below the starting price, each followed by a take-profit sell when it fills.
risks: Fast drops can fill several rungs (bounded by the $500/24h cap)

name: Momentum Rider
summary: Buy on breakout, exit on a trailing stop. Needs a contract change (stop orders).

name: AI Thematic
summary: Your AI reads news and suggests allocation changes within bounds; you approve every trade.

name: Monday Open Planner
summary: Weekend review that queues tight limit orders for the next market open (replaces 'Weekend Edge'; pending decision).
